fixtures.preview: A Sunday 2pm Roses clash at Elland Road, with Michael Carrick's injury-hit United facing a Leeds side that finished 14th last season.
talking_points: Benjamin Sesko has missed United's last two games with a recurring shin problem, and Carrick says there is no timeframe for his return.
Luke Shaw and Kobbie Mainoo were hurt against Spurs and stayed in Manchester for the Atlético trip, so both are doubtful for Sunday.
Patrick Dorgu is reported to be out for several weeks, and Noussair Mazraoui took a knock so his availability is unclear.
Carrick says Carlos Baleba, Amad and Marcus Rashford are all back training to some degree, but none is confirmed fit.

fixtures.preview: United's first competitive meeting with Cesc Fàbregas's Como, a matchday 3 trip to Lake Como.
A Sunday home game against Bournemouth, moved from Saturday for UK TV.
A lunchtime trip to Stamford Bridge with a 12:30pm UK start.
Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford.
The A-League Men season opens tonight with a Friday-night Sydney Derby, with former Sydney FC coach Ufuk Talay now in charge of the Wanderers.
talking_points: Talay left Sydney FC in March and returns to Allianz Stadium as Wanderers coach, saying a hostile reception is 'all part of the game'.
Sydney reached last season's grand final, losing to Auckland FC, while the Wanderers finished with the wooden spoon.
Captain Rhyan Grant, who has played more Sydney-Wanderers games than anyone, says the rivalry is as fierce as ever.
No injury list or confirmed team news was published on the club's match-day page when this was written.
